final: WITH c AS (SELECT f.rating AS rating, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM film_actor fa JOIN film f ON f.film_id = fa.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM c WHERE cnt IS NOT NULL), k AS (SELECT c.rating, c.cnt, a.avg_cnt FROM c JOIN a ON a.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL WHERE c.cnt > a.avg_cnt) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_diff FROM k
